title: Data model for an ISLOPOL process definition
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a reusable process definition in the ISLOPOL value chain, which can be referenced by multiple ProcessEvent or ProductionRun records, covering its name, purpose and triggering condition.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:Process:<facility>:<processId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Process

name.description: Property. Human-readable name of the process. Given in the source as https://schema.org/name.

description.description: Property. Human-readable explanation of the process, including its purpose and the main input materials, resources and outputs.

triggeringCondition.description: Property. Condition or operational requirement that causes the process to be started, such as the need to process accumulated waste. Given in the source as https://context.dataspace-arditi.com/islopol/terms/v2/triggeringCondition.
